trigger: Instrument-validation finding 2026-09-03 (see P12_EVAL_JUDGE_ENGAGEMENT_FINDING_V1.md): under the amended-template codex tuning eval (LUNARC sbatch 3572226) the frozen judge substitution never engaged — 14/68 cells carry RuntimeError('judge shim: AzureOpenAI configured but no Azure credentials exist in this campaign (MODEL_IDENTITY_FREEZE_V1.json: CLI lanes only)') with success_bool=false and eval/tuning/judge_transcripts/ is empty (0 codex judge calls). Root cause: the unmodified upstream gpt4_visual_judge.py selects its client class at module level by 'if os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"): OpenAI() else: AzureOpenAI(...)' — this campaign sets no OPENAI_API_KEY (MODEL_IDENTITY_FREEZE_V1: CLI lanes only), so the upstream always constructs AzureOpenAI, whose shim constructor raised by design; the codex-backed OpenAI substitution was unreachable in any real eval. Judge-smoke job 3570445 (scores [10,5,10]) exercised the shim's OpenAI path directly and could not reveal the branch — the same masked-path shape as the dataset-mountpoint defect this campaign already amended.
